description: make pr-open refuses with 'local oracle review is unavailable: omp version mismatch: installed 18.13.1, CI pins 18.12.1; install the pinned build' and a note that a 'Local oracle override:' line does not cover it. The message gives no way to get the pinned build, although the repo's installer already caches a SHA-256-verified build at ~/.cache/benchbox/omp/<version>/<platform>/omp. The workaround is to put that directory first on PATH for the one command; it was found by looking at another session's cache.
